tagline: Honest Italian cooking in the heart of Munich
seoDescription: Trattoria da Marco in Munich: fresh pasta, pizza and Italian classics. Browse the menu and request a table online.

hero.title: Pasta like Marco's grandmother made it
hero.subtitle: Fresh pasta, Roman classics and a glass of wine at a set table.
hero.imageAlt: A laid table with a checked tablecloth, plate, cutlery and a glass of wine

about.title: A table for everyone
paragraphs: Marco cooks what he grew up eating: pasta made fresh every morning, sauces that simmer for hours and ingredients he is happy to taste himself.
Whether it is a quick lunch or a long evening with friends, there is a seat for you. The menu is also on every table, just scan the QR code.
